summary_en: Safie to acquire 100% stake in Sadoshima Shoji K.K., an insurance agency operator (damage and life insurance) based in Nishinomiya, Hyogo. Deal value and acquisition price per share not disclosed. Integration aims to fuse video-AI technology with insurance risk consulting and underwriting capabilities to develop data-driven insurance products and transition toward future insurance company establishment.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of shares in Sadoshima Shoji K.K. by Safie Inc. (establishment as wholly-owned subsidiary)
translation_en_brief:
On 28 August 2026, Safie Inc. (TSE Growth, code 4375) announced that its board of directors has resolved to acquire all issued shares of Sadoshima Shoji K.K., an insurance agency based in Nishinomiya, Hyogo. Sadoshima Shoji engages in damage and life insurance brokerage and financial services. The target company is being made a wholly-owned subsidiary.

Safie's CEO Ryuhei Sadoshima, who holds a 20% stake in Sadoshima Shoji, abstained from the board discussion and vote to avoid conflicts of interest.

The acquisition is strategic: Safie aims to fuse its video-AI technology platform with insurance risk management and underwriting capabilities. The company states that combining its large proprietary video dataset and AI algorithms with Sadoshima Shoji's insurance consulting expertise and distribution will enable development of data-driven, prevention-focused insurance products (rather than traditional post-event claims settlement). The filing indicates a future path toward establishing Safie's own insurance company and transitioning from pure insurance-brokerage margins to underwriting profits. No transaction value, share count, price per share, or completion timeline is disclosed in the first two pages.
